Import packages
```{r include = TRUE, message=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
```

Import data
```{r }
#Set directory
setwd("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/Spp")
```

Distribution of pairwise genomic differentiation (FST) within each of the nine species (Figure 2)
```{r }
## Load Fst----
BM <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/BM/BM_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
CR <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/CR/CR_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
CX <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/CX/CX_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
EI <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/EI/EI_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
EO <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/EO/EO_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
GA <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/GA/GA_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
LC <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/LC/LC_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
SC <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/SC/SC_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)
XA <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/XA/XA_PairwiseFst_ns.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) %>% as.matrix(.)

##remove top half of matrix (including diagonal)
BM[upper.tri(BM, diag=TRUE)] <- NA 
CR[upper.tri(CR, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
CX[upper.tri(CX, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
EI[upper.tri(EI, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
EO[upper.tri(EO, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
GA[upper.tri(GA, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
LC[upper.tri(LC, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
SC[upper.tri(SC, diag=TRUE)] <- NA
XA[upper.tri(XA, diag=TRUE)] <- NA

#Linearize the distance matrix
BM.melt <- reshape2::melt(BM) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "BM",  Fst.Global ="0.09")
CR.melt <- reshape2::melt(CR) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "CR",  Fst.Global ="0.05")
CX.melt <- reshape2::melt(CX) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "CX",  Fst.Global ="0.07")
EI.melt <- reshape2::melt(EI) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "EI",  Fst.Global ="0.04")
EO.melt <- reshape2::melt(EO) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "EO",  Fst.Global ="0.03")
GA.melt <- reshape2::melt(GA) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "GA",  Fst.Global ="0.09")
LC.melt <- reshape2::melt(LC) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "LC",  Fst.Global ="0.05")
SC.melt <- reshape2::melt(SC) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst')) %>% mutate(Spp = "SC",  Fst.Global ="0.05")
XA.melt <- reshape2::melt(XA) %>% set_colnames(., c('Pop1','Pop2','Fst'))%>% mutate(Spp = "XA",  Fst.Global ="0.03")

Fst.spp <- rbind(BM.melt, CR.melt, CX.melt, EI.melt, EO.melt, GA.melt, LC.melt, SC.melt, XA.melt)
write.csv(Fst.spp, file="Fst.spp.Ch1.csv")

#load significant Fst
Fst.sig.spp <- read.csv("Fst.spp.significant.Ch1.csv")

#Violin Plot Fst----

# Modify the factor levels (facet labels)
Fst.sig.spp$Spp <- factor(Fst.sig.spp$Spp, levels = c("BM","CR", "CX", "EI", "EO", "GA", "LC", "SC", "XA"), 
                 labels = c("Banksia","Callitris","Correa",
                            "Epacris","Eucalyptus","Grevillea",
                            "Leptospermum","Stenanthera","Xanthorrhoea"))

#Set up colour pallete
pal7 <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"RdYlBu"))(100)

Fst.sig.spp %>%                  
  filter( Fst != 'NA') %>% 
  mutate(Spp = fct_reorder(Spp, as.numeric(Fst.Global), .fun = median)) %>%
ggplot(aes(x=Spp, y=Fst, fill=as.numeric(Fst.Global))) + 
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+
   geom_boxplot(width=0.1, fill="white", alpha=0.5)+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = rev(pal7)) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab('Species') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(size=18, face="plain"),
        legend.position="bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.text=element_text(size=10, face="plain"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(colour="black",angle = 55, 
                                   vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour="black",size=18,face="plain"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(colour="black",size=18,face="plain"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(colour="black",size=18,face="plain")) +
guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = expression(paste("F",italic("ST"))),
                             label.position = "bottom",
                             title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.8,
                             frame.colour = "black",
                             barwidth = 10,
                             barheight = 1.5,
                             ticks.colour = "grey30")) 

ggsave(file = "Ch1_Violin.Global.Fst.sig.pdf", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

Comparison of within-population genetic diversity parameters for each of the nine species (Figure 3)
```{r He, Ho, Fis 2}
fis_he_ho_ns <- read.csv("Spp_fis_he_ho_ns.csv")

hetlab.o = expression(italic("H")[o])
hetlab.e = expression(italic("H")[e])

# Modify the factor levels (facet labels)
fis_he_ho_ns$Spp <- factor(fis_he_ho_ns$Spp, levels = c("BM","CR", "CX", "EI", "EO", "GA", "LC", "SC", "XA"), 
                 labels = c("Banksia","Callitris","Correa",
                            "Epacris","Eucalyptus","Grevillea",
                            "Leptospermum","Stenanthera","Xanthorrhoea"))

ggplot(fis_he_ho_ns, aes(exp_het, obs_het)) +
  geom_point(colour = "black", 
             fill = "#6baed6", 
             shape = 21, 
             size = 3, 
             alpha = 0.8) +
  #geom_point(mapping=aes(size=fis,
  #                       alpha=0.5,
  #                       fill=fis),
  #           colour = "black",
  #           shape=21) +
  ylab(hetlab.o) + xlab(hetlab.e) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~Spp) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 18),
        legend.title=element_text(size=18, face="plain"),
        legend.position="bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.text=element_text(size=10, face="plain"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(colour="black", 
                                   vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=18),
        #plot.margin = margin(0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, "cm"),
        #margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt")
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour="black",size=18,face="plain"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(colour="black",size=18,face="plain"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(colour="black",size=18,face="plain")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = expression(paste("F",italic("ST"))),
                               label.position = "bottom",
                               title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.8,
                               frame.colour = "black",
                               barwidth = 10,
                               barheight = 1.5,
                               ticks.colour = "grey30")) +
  #  geom_label_repel(aes(label = pop_new),
  #                   color = "black", 
  #                   fontface = "bold",
  #                   segment.color = "grey30",
  #                   segment.size = 1,
  #                   min.segment.length = 0.1,
  #                   na.rm = TRUE,
  #                   show.legend = TRUE,
  #                   max.overlaps = 70) + 
  guides(alpha="none", size = "none")

ggsave(file = "Ch1_Fis.He.Ho.spp.pdf", width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file = "Ch1_Fis.He.Ho.spp.labels.2.pdf", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
